conbody.p: Equity share capital has distinct features which define its risk and return. These features determine the suitability of raising equity capital for the company over other sources of financing such as debt. The equity shareholders have specific rights and privileges in the company as compared to debt holders. Some of the rights of common shareholders are discussed below:
